entities.name: GMR Smart Electricity Distribution Private Limited

operating_notes.text: Smart meters installed reached ~39 lakh across all project areas as of 30 Apr 2026.
Infomerics rates ₹380 Cr of IDBI Bank guarantee facilities IVR BBB/Stable; Union Bank of India guarantee facilities were closed and the rating withdrawn on a no-dues certificate.

GMR Coal Resources Pte. Ltd., a Singapore step-down wholly owned subsidiary, was dissolved with effect from October 1, 2026; it recorded nil turnover and an insignificant net worth contribution in the last financial year.

holders.name: SYNERGY INDUSTRIALS, METALS AND POWER HOLDINGS LTD

timeline.summary: GMR Power and Urban Infra extended a ₹240 Cr corporate guarantee to IDBI Bank for three smart meter step-down subsidiaries.
GMR Power released its monitoring agency report for Q4FY26 showing ₹900 Cr of preferential issue proceeds received and fully utilized.
2026-05-29: Infomerics upgraded GMR Power's ₹380 Cr IDBI Bank guarantee to IVR BBB/Stable and withdrew the Union Bank guarantee rating after closure.
GMR Estate Management announced the proposed acquisition of a 9.55% stake in GMR Power through an off-market promoter transfer.
GMR Power and Urban Infra entered into an agreement to divest its 26% stake in Portus Ventures Private Limited to Adani Airport City Limited for ₹36,400.
GMR Power dissolved its Singapore step-down subsidiary GMR Coal Resources effective October 1, 2026.
